manualWalk.method: Selected the fishing site once in walk mode, then used native WASD keys with camera direction shortcuts only. No intermediate position changes or automatic route movement.

observations.place: public road after return through gate

manualWalk.outcome: Entered, climbed, descended and returned without blockage or missing floor. Upper and lower walking surfaces remained separate.

geometry.roadClearance: Both deck outlines are clipped at least 0.35m from the full 8m diagonal public road.
geometry.bridge: Road centre x=26.5, half width=3; wood bridge starts x=29.7, with a 0.2m abutment.

verification.broadRun: 80 tests across 14 Vitest files; initial table-count expectation and deck/road overlap failures corrected and rechecked in focused suites.
verification.roundedRoadAndTreeIsland: Passed after reducing the small island tree to fit its canopy clearance.
verification.vehicleScenarios: 36 bicycle/scooter sweeps on three routes, both directions and three lane positions passed.
verification.visualReview: Final Chrome views confirmed rounded entrance, tiled wall caps covered by roof, continuous cafe verge, bridge ending at the public road edge, and two-storey timber fishing deck/stairs/rails.

remoteWrites: No commit, push, MR, merge, deploy, Jenkins execution or branch deletion.
limits: Local standalone preview only; actual server rental/network flows and a VR headset were not tested.
